title: Elliptic squares and Zilber–Pink for curves in A2
summary: We prove that every Hodge-generic algebraic curve in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$ contains only finitely many points whose abelian surface is isogenous to the square of an elliptic curve without complex multiplication (CM). Combining this result with the companion $`E\times\mathrm{CM}`$ and quaternionic-division finiteness theorems, we prove the curve case of Zilber–Pink in $`\mathcal A_2`$ over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$, without a boundary hypothesis.
family_title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold

review.reason: Proves finiteness results for elliptic squares on curves in the moduli space A2.
